accountable-doorway.today_note: custody and key export are live; governance by the people who come through a doorway is designed
accountable-doorway.rationale: The operator's authority is a signed commitment carried into every session; canon makes the doorway answerable to those who ingress through it, never a party that governs its users.

security_breach.today_note: encryption and export are live; today the doorway still keeps an encrypted copy after you leave
security_breach.rationale: Hosted keys are encrypted at rest with the person's password, and graduation to one's own device is a running flow. Hosting is a stage and not a destination.

right_object.rationale: Closing an account and exporting a key are running flows; what you signed stays signed by your key wherever you go.

available_to_the_accountable_organizatio.rationale: This is the honest exception: at the hosted stage the middle-out reading is the accurate one, and the label says so.

data_retained.today_note: accounts are closed by marking them closed; log limits and full erasure are being built
data_retained.rationale: The canon bounds doorway logs by the same retention floor as every other projection.
